overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board met in person at a posted, physically accessible location, so it was not required to provide live remote access, though remote access was encouraged.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board met in person on April 5, 2021 but failed to provide live remote access to the meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find that the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law when it met in person and did not provide live access to the meeting via remote means.
